description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractRule that extends a validation rule from the Respect Validation library. It provides a custom implementation of reportError method that throws a ValidationException, used as a base class for custom validation rules in the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: AbstractRule
classes.description: An abstract class extending RespectValidation's AbstractRule, customized to throw a specific ValidationException during validation errors.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Overrides the RespectValidation's reportError method to throw a ValidationException with provided input and rule context.
